thread:
maria: quick q — noticed a couple of PRs where ArgoCD started syncing while Atlantis was still applying and we got flapping manifests. should we add an explicit handshake (post-apply webhook) or just have a GH Action step that polls argocd until the app is stable? cc @alex @santiago

alex: i've seen the flip-flop too. two reasonable approaches: 1) post-apply webhook from Atlantis -> CI (preferred, source-of-truth is apply), 2) GH Action that polls argocd status after apply. webhook is cleaner and avoids racy polling, but GH Action fallback is useful for retries. :+1:

santiago: if we go polling, use the argocd CLI `argocd app wait <app>` with both health+sync checks. beware hooks/crons that can report healthy but still reconciling — combine `app get` status checks. also add a timeout and exponential backoff.

maria: can you paste a minimal GH Action step for the argocd wait? also worried about secrets — some manifests are rendered with sops in the pipeline, if apply happens too early that's bad.

alex: heres a small example we can drop into the infra workflow:
```yaml
- name: Wait for ArgoCD app ready
  uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Install argocd CLI
  run: curl -sSL -o /usr/local/bin/argocd https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/releases/latest/download/argocd-linux-amd64 && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/argocd
- name: Wait for app sync+health
  env:
    ARGOCD_SERVER: ${{ secrets.ARGOCD_SERVER }}
    ARGOCD_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ARGOCD_TOKEN }}
    APP: infra-namespace-app
  run: |
    argocd login $ARGOCD_SERVER --token $ARGOCD_TOKEN --insecure
    # wait for sync + healthy, 5m timeout
    argocd app wait $APP --sync --health --timeout 300
    argocd app get $APP --refresh
```

liz: on secrets: we must not expose SOPS keys or ARGOCD_TOKEN to forked PR workflows. better to keep `atlantis apply` in protected runners with the key and have Atlantis send a signed internal webhook to CI. GH Actions should use read-only tokens for polling, and any apply-only secrets live only in the Atlantis environment.

maria: good call. plan: add a `post_apply` script in the atlantis repo that POSTs to `/internal/ci/argocd-handshake` with repo/plan/id and a short-lived HMAC token. CI job will wait for that webhook for up to 2m then fall back to argocd polling for another 3m. i'll open a draft PR.

infra-bot: atlantis: apply finished for plan 987 on repo infra-configs (maria) :white_check_mark:

santiago: one more security note — include a nonce/timestamp in the webhook payload and verify HMAC server-side to avoid replay. also exponential backoff for GH Action polling (start 5s -> 30s). keep total wait under our SLA (6m).

alex: agree. also update `docs/infra-ci.md` with the sequence diagram and the GH Action snippet + example webhook payload. makes future debuggability easier.

maria: i'll add the docs in the PR and ping for async review tomorrow morning. @liz can you double-check the secrets access/runner scope when you have a moment? if no objections i'll land monday. thanks all :heart:
